structured.reason: an alert is firing on a production service

entries.text: Upstream latency to payments-provider went from 12s to 30s inside the window [e1] while the catalogue upstream stayed flat, and the error log records an upstream payment timeout after 30s [e2]. The serialiser warning is a fallback notice, not an error: this is not a serialisation problem in checkout itself.

structured.root_cause: the payment provider is timing out and checkout returns 5xx while waiting
structured.summary: Latency to the payments-provider upstream tripled inside the window [e1] and checkout logs an upstream timeout after 30s [e2]. The catalogue upstream is unaffected, and the cart serialiser warning is a fallback notice rather than the cause.
causal_chain: the payment provider started responding in 30s instead of 12s
checkout's upstream call hit its timeout
checkout returned 5xx to its own callers
remediation_steps: shorten the upstream timeout and fail fast with a queued retry
raise the outage with the payment provider
recommended_actions: shorten the upstream timeout and fail fast with a queued retry
raise the outage with the payment provider
